_note: The plant-and-payoff table from narrative-spine.md, as data. This file drives nothing on its own — it exists so that a playtest report can show whether each seeded thread was actually planted in a given run, and so that removing a lead or document that a later beat depends on shows up as a broken thread rather than a mystery. Treat it as the narrative equivalent of a schema.

threads.name: The scrubber catalyst nobody mines
threads._note: The load-bearing thread. Planting is ambient — the player notices they never mine it whether or not they buy the lead — so payoff never depends on a purchase.

threads.name: The hidden passage
threads._note: Optional plant, mandatory payoff. A player who never read the schematic still gets the entry; they just do not get the click of recognition.

threads.name: The mole on the Board
threads._note: Planted by the player's own behaviour rather than by content: the mole is whoever they trusted most. Nothing to write, and the strongest thread in the game.

threads.name: The video feed of the surface
threads._note: Deliberately unpaid in v1. paidOff.via is empty because Chapter 3 does not exist yet — that emptiness is correct, not a gap to fill.

threads.name: The word 'Facility'
threads._note: The theme hiding in a piece of vocabulary. The Nexus must NEVER say 'Shaft' — every directive and mandate clause says Facility and a number. This is the one thread enforced by a writing rule rather than a mechanism, which is why it is listed here: so the rule has somewhere to live.
